title: Temporal Shackles
next_chapter_hook: Just when despair set in, Chen Ji remembered the resonance between the Turtle Shell and the Axis of Fate—perhaps there was a method to 'overlay' rather than 'rewrite'

text.content: Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, a waning moon hung like a hook. Chen Ji sat cross-legged at the Cliff Edge, the Tianji Record Fragment floating before his knees, ancient golden runes flickering uncertainly in the darkness. He had been seated here for seven days, repeatedly deducing the ultimate mystery of that forbidden technique. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered from the depths of his consciousness: 'The 723rd prophecy... are you certain you wish to know the answer?' Chen Ji closed his eyes, the blue veins at his brow center throbbing faintly: 'If I do not know, I will forever be a chess piece manipulated by fate.'

The Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light, a vision like a tidal wave flooding into Chen Ji's mind—it was a void, vast and endless, and at the very center of this void, the entire world resembled a massive bronze mirror, crumbling inch by inch from the edges. Mountains, rivers, sects, mortals... everything was turning to dust, and time itself seemed to be forcibly snapped in half. This was the sight of a timeline collapsing? Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, cold sweat soaking through his back.

dialogue.content: 'You saw it?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed. 'This is the price of rewriting fate. Even if one merely reverses a single destined event from the prophecies, the timeline will crumble inch by inch, like silk gnawed through by insects, starting from that point.' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse: 'Then if I break all 723 prophecies—' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment: 'The entire world's lifespan will be shortened by another three hundred years from this moment.'

text.content: Three hundred years. Chen Ji clenched his fist until his knuckles turned white. What did this mean? It meant that if he followed his plan to rewrite fate step by step, at most seven hundred years remained before this world would completely perish. He could save Su Qingyao, defeat Han Lie, destroy the Demonic Holy Sect—and then what? By the time he completed all his schemes, the world would also reach its end. Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that laughter echoing through the silent night sky, carrying an indescribable bitterness and madness.

Chen Ji abruptly stood up, his crimson-red eyes gazing into the Void, as if he could pierce through endless time and space, seeing those eyes that had always been watching him: 'Eye of Heavenly Dao... what a fine scheme of using a blade.' He murmured, 'You let me believe the Tianji Record was a weapon to break fate, not knowing it was merely a tool for you to accelerate the world's destruction.' The night sky was silent, as if mocking his belated realization.

dialogue.content: 'You finally understand.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke with complex emotions: 'Every successor of the Tianji Record has unconsciously served as an executioner. The harder they try to change fate, the more they shorten the lifespan of this heaven and earth. The three great sects, the old sect leader, the Demonic Holy Sect... they may not be unaware of this truth, yet they have tacitly concealed it, simply because they need you to serve as that blade.' Chen Ji coldly smiled: 'What a fine enemy of the entire world.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell back to the ground, gazing up at the moon. Countless images flashed through his mind—Su Qingyao's doubts when she thrice came close to the truth, Ye Qing's despair in her eyes when forced into cooperation, even Ling Yuan's subtle malice... everyone was using him, yet he had been utterly unaware as he pushed himself into the abyss. More ridiculous still, he had believed himself to be the Chess Player. Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes: 'I need a method to break fate without rewriting the timeline.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji fell into deep thought, three possible paths emerging in his mind:

choices.description: The resonance between the Turtle Shell and the Axis of Fate might create an effect of 'overlaying' rather than 'rewriting'—opening a new tributary outside the timeline.
choices.visible_cost: Need to re-deduce the connections between all prophecies
choices.visible_reward: Might find a method to break the situation without timeline collapse
choices.risk_hint: Success rate unknown, requires both Turtle Shell and Axis of Fate present simultaneously

text.content: Chen Ji took out the battered Turtle Shell from his chest, his fingertips tracing the mottled patterns on its surface. A faint glow emanated from the shell's surface, creating an imperceptible resonance with something deep within the Forbidden Grounds. His pupils constricted: 'Father... you knew this day would come, didn't you?'

choices.description: Expose the conspiracies of the three great sects, the Demonic Holy Sect, and even the Heavenly Dao in one fell swoop, using public opinion pressure to force concessions. But this equals declaring war on all powers simultaneously.
choices.visible_cost: Offend the three great sects and the Demonic Holy Sect at the same time
choices.visible_reward: Break the information gap, preventing enemy schemes from continuing
choices.risk_hint: Lose protection from all powers, may face joint pursuit and assassination

text.content: A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth: 'Since they want to use me as a blade, I'll let them见识一下 this blade's backlash can cut.' He rose, his robes rustling in the wind, a resolute light flickering in his eyes.

choices.description: Use the Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze against it, reversely deduce its schemes, and detonate all conflicts before enemy plans are complete, seeking victory through chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may die on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Find a sliver of opportunity amid chaos
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's specific abilities are unknown

text.content: A resolute light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: 'Nothing ventured, nothing gained.' He began frantically deducing the Eye of Heavenly Dao's schemes, attempting to find flaws in that transcendent consciousness. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shrieked: 'You've lost your mind!' But Chen Ji was deaf to all, determined to dance on the blade's edge.

Just then, an icy gaze pierced through the void. Every hair on Chen Ji's body stood on end as he abruptly looked up to find a massive eye had opened in the depths of the night sky. The pupil was composed of countless golden runes, profound and endless, as if containing the ultimate truths of heaven and earth. The Eye of Heavenly Dao. It had been watching all along. Chen Ji felt a chill surge from the soles of his feet to his very soul—every thought, every deduction, had been exposed beneath that gaze.

dialogue.content: A grand and ruthless voice resounded in Chen Ji's mind: 'Ant, you have finally perceived a fragment of truth.' Chen Ji's entire body stiffened, yet he forced a cold smile: 'So, having the Tianji Record's inheritors serve as executioners is also part of your scheme?' The Eye of Heavenly Dao showed no emotional波动: 'The world's end is inevitable. I am merely accelerating this process to welcome a new cycle.'

text.content: A new cycle? Chen Ji's pupils constricted. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice continued to reverberate: 'This heaven and earth has entered decline. Repairing it would require vast stretches of time. Only by ending it prematurely can new life be gestated within the void.' Chen Ji suddenly understood something: 'So you are not merely using me—you are using every Tianji Record inheritor. Each successor is a sickle you wield to harvest time.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent for a moment, then from that massive pupil actually emerged a hint of... amusement?

dialogue.content: 'You are smarter than all seven predecessors.' That ruthless voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind. 'Unfortunately, knowing the truth changes nothing. You will still walk the path of destiny's script, because you have no other choice.' Chen Ji clenched his fist, nails digging deep into his palms. The Eye of Heavenly Dao spoke true—even knowing the abyss lay ahead, he could not stop his steps. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Chen Nian... his weaknesses were too numerous, enough to keep him tethered to fate's leash.

choice.prompt: Faced with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pressure, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Lower Head and Lie in Wait, Endure and Bide Time
choices.description: Temporarily accept fate's script, secretly seek methods to break the situation. When the enemy is strong and we are weak, showing weakness is the wisest choice.
choices.visible_reward: Gain breathing room, seek the true breakthrough point

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his head, his voice hoarse: '...I understand.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao blinked with satisfaction, and that massive pupil gradually dissipated into the night sky. But just as the light was about to vanish completely, Chen Ji caught an imperceptible fluctuation—a frequency only产生的 when the Turtle Shell resonates with the Axis of Fate.

choices.description: Since the mask has been torn away, might as well ask for more inside information. The fact that the Eye of Heavenly Dao revealed itself means there are still variables beyond its complete control.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao and suffer backlash
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information, discern the enemy's weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's backlash is unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, an unyielding light flashing in his eyes: 'Since you've always been watching, you should know—Chen Ji never plays by the book.' He raised the Turtle Shell high above his head, its mottled surface beginning to emanate blinding light. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil slightly contracted, that eternally ice-cold pressure actually showing a trace of fluctuation.

That fluctuation lasted only an instant, yet it was enough for Chen Ji to捕获 key information. His pupils constricted—the Turtle Shell! The Turtle Shell his father left him could actually produce a reaction under the Eye of Heavenly Dao's gaze! What did this mean? It meant the resonance between the Turtle Shell and the Axis of Fate was not only effective on timelines—it could even interfere with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's perception! Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the wild joy in his heart, revealing nothing on his face. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice sounded again: 'What are you thinking?'

dialogue.content: A faint smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, a gentle, harmless expression: 'The junior merely wonders, since the senior is so all-powerful, why go to the trouble of using the Tianji Record to manipulate us? Wouldn't it be simpler to directly proclaim destiny?' The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent for three breaths, golden runes swirling within that pupil, seemingly judging the true intent behind Chen Ji's words. After a moment, it spoke: 'There are some things, even I, cannot directly intervene in.'

text.content: Chen Ji's heart shook violently. This was the first time the Eye of Heavenly Dao admitted its limitations. 'Cannot directly intervene'—these six words meant that though the Eye of Heavenly Dao was lofty, it was not omniscient or omnipotent. It needed the Tianji Record, needed inheritors, needed chess pieces on the board, to indirectly influence this world. In other words, it also had weaknesses! Chen Ji lowered his gaze, concealing the explosive light in his eyes. Mo Xiansheng was right—as long as that weakness could be found, this dead game could be brought back to life.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed to sense something, that massive pupil suddenly pressing closer, runes swirling to emit suffocating pressure: 'You are scheming against me?' Chen Ji felt his blood and qi churning wildly, his skull about to be ripped open. But he gritted his teeth, forcibly stabilizing his stance, instead revealing a composed smile: 'The junior dares not. The junior merely wonders what other secrets the Turtle Shell left by his father might hold.' He deliberately steered the topic toward the Turtle Shell, attempting to extract more information from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's reactions.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji decided to further test the Eye of Heavenly Dao's attitude toward the Turtle Shell:

choices.text: Retreat to Advance, Seek the Secret
choices.description: Adopt an earnest, seeking attitude, test the Eye of Heavenly Dao's true attitude toward the Turtle Shell. The more it conceals, the more it reveals something it fears within.
choices.visible_cost: May expose his own regard for the Turtle Shell
choices.visible_reward: Judge the Turtle Shell's value from the other's reactions
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may see through his disguise

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his posture respectfully flawless: 'The junior is foolish, unaware of the Turtle Shell's origins, I implore the senior for guidance.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent. Within those golden pupils, the speed of rune circulation suddenly accelerated sharply, as if performing some intense calculation. Chen Ji observed this, his heart growing more convinced—the Turtle Shell was absolutely no simple object.

choices.text: Coerce and Lure, Reveal Cards for a Game
choices.description: Directly point out the fact that the Turtle Shell can interfere with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's perception, using this as leverage to exchange for concessions on certain matters.
choices.visible_cost: Completely opposed to the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: May obtain crucial information or substantial concessions
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may choose direct annihilation

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze fixed directly on the Eye of Heavenly Dao, his voice calm yet carrying undeniable sharpness: 'The senior just said the Turtle Shell can resonate with you. The junior would like to know—is this so-called 'resonance' a blessing or a curse for the senior?' The Eye of Heavenly Dao did not answer immediately, but within that massive pupil, the speed of rune circulation noticeably slowed.

A long silence. The night wind suddenly rose, rustling Chen Ji's robes and blowing away the cold sweat at his temples. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's presence was too vast, too transcendent, so much so that merely being watched by it felt like bearing the weight of the entire heaven and earth. The hand Chen Ji used to grip the Turtle Shell trembled slightly, yet he stood straight, confronting that massive pupil. Finally, the Eye of Heavenly Dao spoke, and for the first time, a hint of... wariness? appeared in its voice.

dialogue.content: 'Your father...' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rare exhibited a pause. 'Knew more than I imagined.' Chen Ji's heart shook violently. Father? An ordinary Outer Disciple of Tianqing Sect, an old man still murmuring about the Turtle Shell at death's door... he actually knew secrets that even the Eye of Heavenly Dao feared? The Eye of Heavenly Dao continued: 'That relic should not have existed in this era. Your appearance has broken the most crucial balance in my plan.'

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly understood something. He slowly spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'Father said before death that 'the Turtle Shell is merely one of the keys'—is the other relic the Axis of Fate?' The Eye of Heavenly Dao gave no answer, but that silence itself was the answer. Chen Ji laughed toward the sky, his laughter bleak yet畅快: 'Excellent! Excellent indeed, Heavenly Dao! So even you have things beyond your calculation!' He pressed the Turtle Shell against his chest, his eyes slightly red: 'Father, rest assured... this game, I will not lose.'

Just when despair set in, Chen Ji remembered the resonance between the Turtle Shell and the Axis of Fate—there might be a method to 'overlay' rather than 'rewrite'. A fleeting thought from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly surfaced in his mind: the River of Time is not singular, but composed of countless tributaries. If power could be injected into the Axis of Fate that 'overlays' rather than 'rewrites' without touching the original timeline, an entirely new tributary could be carved atop the ruins of the old world. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, brilliant light blazing within.

'Overlay...' Chen Ji murmured to himself, his fingertips unconsciously tracing the patterns on the Turtle Shell. 'Not rewriting the timeline, but creating a new tributary, causing old prophecies to naturally失效 within the new timeline...' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul剧烈波动 in the depths of his consciousness: 'You... you've figured it out?' Chen Ji gave no answer, but abruptly stood up, gazing toward the depths of the Forbidden Grounds. There, the Axis of Fate was emanating a faint glow, as if awaiting something. He knew the next action would determine the final outcome of this game.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed to sense Chen Ji's transformation, that massive pupil suddenly pressing closer, pressure surging like a tide. But this time, Chen Ji did not retreat. Instead, he stepped forward into that pressure, raising the Turtle Shell high. 'The senior just said, 'cannot directly intervene'.' Chen Ji's voice was calm yet firm. 'Then the junior ventures to ask—if the junior finds a method to 'overlay' rather than 'rewrite', how does the senior intend to respond?' The night wind howled, heaven and earth fell silent, and within that massive pupil, for the first time, the speed of rune circulation showed obvious disorder.
